description: This file defines an enumeration SignificantLocationMonitor that manages significant location change monitoring on iOS devices. It initiates monitoring based on the location mode, verifies authorization status, and sends location updates as JSON payloads through a gateway when location changes are detected.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: A Codable struct used to encode location data (latitude, longitude, accuracy, and source) into JSON to be sent to the gateway.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes significant location change monitoring if the location mode is set to always and the app has the necessary authorization. When location updates occur, it encodes the location data into JSON and sends it via the gateway, optionally executing a callback before sending.
